description: Defines a struct 'DeviceInfos' that contains information about physical devices like displays or printers, including size, resolution, DPI, and scale factors, with a method to retrieve device info from a device context handle.

classes.name: DeviceInfos
classes.description: A struct that holds device information such as size, resolution, DPI, and scale factors, with a static method to obtain device info from a device context handle.

methods.name: GetInfos
methods.description: Retrieves device information from a device context handle (IntPtr hdc) and calculates physical DPI and scale ratios.
